_note: 演示区中英对照表。键是渲染出来的中文文本（空白已折叠），值是英文。由 assets/js/demo-i18n.js 在语言切到 EN 时按文本节点替换，切回中文时还原。数字在匹配时会被抹成占位符，所以带动态数值的句子也能命中（值里的数字按出现顺序回填）。刻意不收录：程序输出（console 里的 JSON dump）与代码块里的中文注释 —— 那些是运行结果与示例代码，不属于解说文案。前缀规则（prefixes）用于「答案：+ 动态名称」这类拼接串：先翻前缀，再把剩下的部分丢回词典查一次。

strings.CIE Lab 是感知均匀的颜色空间。a* 横轴（红↔绿），b* 纵轴（黄↔蓝）: CIE Lab is a perceptually uniform colour space: a* runs red↔green, b* runs yellow↔blue, and L* sets lightness.
strings.三种 RGB 工作色域（sRGB / Adobe RGB / Rec.2020）: The three working RGB gamuts (sRGB / Adobe RGB / Rec.2020) nest inside Lab — the larger the gamut, the more colours it can express.
strings.：色域内任意两点距离 ≈ 人眼感知差: : the distance between any two points in the gamut ≈ the difference the eye sees
strings.实际显示色域是 sRGB（约三角内），超出色域的颜色会被 clamp 回 sRG: The display gamut is really sRGB (roughly inside the triangle); colours outside it get clamped back to sRGB → visible distortion
strings.Adobe RGB 涵盖绿色更广（看印刷/摄影），Rec.2020 涵盖 4K: Adobe RGB covers more greens (print, photography); Rec.2020 covers 4K TV
strings.调整 L* 滑块：L* 越低，色域面积越小（暗色只能 saturate 有限）: Move the L* slider: the lower L* is, the smaller the gamut (dark colours can only be so saturated)

strings.彩虹色 ✗ 亮度与色相同时跳变，会在数据里造出并不存在的「条纹」，人眼还会把黄色: Rainbow ✗ lightness and hue jump at the same time, inventing bands that are not in the data — and the eye reads yellow as a peak.
strings.发散型 ✗ 它替读者宣布「有一个中点」，可这组数据没有中点的语义。: Diverging ✗ it tells the reader there is a midpoint, when this dataset has no midpoint semantics.
strings.Jet 非感知均匀 + CVD 不友好 + 打印不友好: Jet: not perceptually uniform, not CVD-friendly, not print-friendly
strings.红绿对红绿色盲完全不可分辨（约 6% 男性）: red and green are indistinguishable to red–green colour-blind readers (about 6% of men)

strings.时间是有序的。两个事件发生的时间有先后次序，与因果关系紧密相连。: Time is ordered: two events happen in a definite sequence, and that order is tightly bound to causation.
strings.火车时刻表、事件日志（log）、git commit history: Timetables, event logs, git commit history

strings.时间与空间紧相关，但科学过程大多将它们独立处理。: Time and space are tightly coupled, yet most scientific charts treat them separately.
strings.折线图 x 轴只用时间、y 轴只用度量；时序不混用空间: On a line chart the x axis carries time and the y axis the measure; do not mix space into a time axis
strings.时间尺度分年/月/日/时/分/秒，分割既有自然反映（昼夜）也有人为定义。: Scales run year/month/day/hour/minute/second; some boundaries follow nature (day and night), others are conventions.
